title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.5.53
body_markdown:
* Added: Support for the new OpenAI GPT-5 model in chat.
* Added: New setting to manage automatic approval of tool usage.
* Added: Option to limit the number of Copilot Agent mode requests per turn.
* Added: GitHub OAuth authentication support for remote MCP servers.
* Added: Ability to disable MCP support via Copilot policies.
* Added: Quick access to MCP settings directly from the log panel.
* Added: Support \*.instructions.md for project scoped customisation. You can now define a Markdown file with the .instructions.md suffix in the .github/instructions directory.
* Changed: Removed support for TIFF and TIF image formats in Copilot Vision.
* Fixed: Resolved issue with MCP remote server connectivity when behind a proxy.
* Fixed: Bug where the Agent service failed to initialize in certain scenarios.
* Fixed: Unexpected display of inline diff view when starting a new session or switching chat modes.
* Fixed: Improved reliability of the run\_in\_terminal tool in Agent mode.
* Fixed: Restricted the list\_dir tool to only access files within workspace folders.
